cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.

mechanism: A manages the common tea queue, acknowledges a donor and fixes blocked recognition while keeping them in the official line.
confusable: Unlike rejecting the donor importance, A supplies the recognition while asking them to abandon the private queue demand.
comparison: Public thanks and urn placement differ from a claim form and driver questioning.
seedUse: D180-b tent donor, thank-you board and urn; S02-b fixes visibility to preserve cooperation with shared process.
